tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for charts, dashboards, notebooks, experiments, events, properties, cohorts, and other Amplitude content.

tools.name: get_from_url
tools.description: Retrieve the full object definition from any Amplitude URL, including charts, dashboards, and experiments.

tools.name: get_amplitude_context
tools.description: Get the current user, organization, and accessible projects. Call it with a project ID to get that project's settings instead, including time zone, currency, session definition, and AI context.

tools.name: query_amplitude_data
tools.description: Execute ad-hoc analytics queries for event segmentation, funnels, retention, and more, and query existing charts by ID, using a two-mode discover/execute workflow.

tools.name: get_amplitude_charts
tools.description: Retrieve chart definitions and data by ID, including events, properties, and configuration.

tools.name: render_amplitude_chart
tools.description: Render a visual, interactive Amplitude chart from a query definition and return a chart edit URL.

tools.name: use_amplitude_chart_monitors
tools.description: Create, read, and manage chart alerts and monitors, including alert history.

tools.name: use_amp_dashboards
tools.description: Get, create, and edit dashboards, including metadata (title, description) and layout changes such as adding, removing, and reordering charts and sections. Saves temporary chart edits into permanent charts automatically, with optimistic concurrency protection.

tools.name: use_amp_notebooks
tools.description: Get, create, and edit interactive notebooks, including charts, rich text, and multi-column layouts, with optimistic concurrency protection.

tools.name: use_amp_comments
tools.description: Read and add comments on Amplitude content.

tools.name: share_amp_entities
tools.description: Manage sharing and access roles for charts, dashboards, notebooks, and other Amplitude entities.

tools.name: use_amplitude_cohorts
tools.description: Retrieve, create, and sync cohorts. Check cohort membership, list sync destinations and history, and export cohort CSVs. Cohort syncs preview the export and ask for confirmation before sending to a destination such as Braze, Iterable, S3, or a webhook.

tools.name: get_amp_user_data
tools.description: Retrieve user profiles, properties, and activity timelines for a project.

tools.name: get_experiments
tools.description: Retrieve experiments by ID with state, variant configuration, and decision details.

tools.name: query_experiment
tools.description: Query experiment analysis data, including variant performance and statistical significance.

tools.name: create_experiment
tools.description: Create A/B test experiments across one or more projects with custom variants and metrics.

tools.name: update_experiment
tools.description: Set or replace metrics on an experiment.

tools.name: create_metric
tools.description: Create reusable metrics (KPIs) for use in experiments or dashboards.

tools.name: get_flags
tools.description: Retrieve feature flag definitions by ID, including variants and configuration.

tools.name: create_flags
tools.description: Create multiple feature flags in batch.

tools.name: update_flag
tools.description: Update a feature flag or experiment's metadata, variants, testers, and deployments.

tools.name: get_deployments
tools.description: Retrieve all deployments (API keys for flags and experiments) for a project.

tools.name: manage_amp_events
tools.description: Retrieve, create, update, delete, and restore events, custom events, and labeled (autotrack) events, including their definitions and metadata.

tools.name: get_properties
tools.description: Retrieve properties from a project's taxonomy. Use `propertyType` to select event, user, group, derived, or other property kinds.

tools.name: create_properties
tools.description: Create event, user, or group properties in a project's tracking plan.

tools.name: update_properties
tools.description: Update a property's description, category, name, or official status. Use `propertyType` to select the kind of property to update.

tools.name: get_transformations
tools.description: Retrieve data transformations from a project. Transformations clean data by merging events, merging properties, or mapping property values.

tools.name: get_group_types
tools.description: List a project's group types, the categories of groups, such as Company, Team, or Account.

tools.name: manage_amp_data_taxonomy
tools.description: Get workspace context for a Data project or portfolio, and manage the tracking-plan branch workflow: create, update, delete, merge, review, and refresh branches.

tools.name: get_session_replays
tools.description: Search for session replays from the last 30 days, filtered by user properties or events.

tools.name: list_session_replays
tools.description: List session replays with simple time-range pagination.

tools.name: get_session_replay_events
tools.description: Retrieve processed interaction timelines from a session replay recording.

tools.name: list_guides_surveys
tools.description: List guides and surveys in a project, with filters by type, platform, creator, date range, and archived status. Returns status, priority, and creator metadata for each item.

tools.name: get_guide_or_survey
tools.description: Retrieve full details for a single guide or survey by ID, including status, priority, variants, step content, page targeting rules, and trigger configuration.

tools.name: query_wave_opportunities
tools.description: Search and retrieve Wave opportunities and their details.

tools.name: query_wave_product_areas
tools.description: Search and retrieve Wave product areas.

tools.name: manage_wave_opportunities
tools.description: Create, update, and relate Wave opportunities.

tools.name: manage_wave_product_areas
tools.description: Create and update Wave product areas.

tools.name: manage_wave_verification_artifacts
tools.description: Attach and manage verification artifacts on Wave opportunities.

tools.name: use_amplitude_ai_feedback
tools.description: Query and analyze customer feedback from connected sources. Retrieves processed themes grouped by type (feature requests, bugs, complaints, praise, and pain points), raw comments with search and pagination, individual comments associated with a specific insight, connected feedback integrations and their source IDs, and saved customer feedback trends tracked over time.

tools.name: get_agent_results
tools.description: Retrieve results from AI agents that analyzed your dashboards or session replays.

tools.name: get_amplitude_agent_analytics_info
tools.description: Query AI agent analytics: quality, cost, performance, error, and trend metrics; sessions and spans; conversation transcripts and full-text search; and the available schema, rubric definitions, and filter values.

tools.name: get_data_ingestion_sources
tools.description: List ingestion sources for a project, including SDKs, warehouse imports, and third party integrations.

tools.name: get_data_source_details
tools.description: Get configuration and metadata for one ingestion source.

tools.name: get_data_warehouse_destinations
tools.description: List export destinations for a project, including type, status, and last export timing.

tools.name: get_data_warehouse_jobs
tools.description: Get batch job history for one import source or export destination: status, timing, records processed, errors, and failure reason.

tools.name: list_tool_categories
tools.description: List available product surface categories for progressive tool discovery.

tools.name: get_category_tools
tools.description: Discover tools in a given product surface category for progressive tool discovery.

tools.name: describe_tool
tools.description: Get the latest schema and required parameters for a specific tool during progressive tool discovery.
